chunks: One of his officers built a stately house,
ai.seo_question: What did Amīr al-mu’minīn say about an officer who built a lavish house?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) observes an official’s ostentatious house as a visible indicator of his financial status, reflecting the Shia principle that public wealth should not be concealed in private luxury. This incident underscores the Imam’s emphasis on transparency and accountability in governance, where the outward appearance of officials serves as a mirror to their internal integrity and relationship with the treasury (Bayt al-Mal).

en.sayed-ali-raza: 355. One of the officers of Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, built a stately house,
